     Queen of the Meadow. Compositæ.

     An old Indian medicine, used by herb doctors, particularly in gravel and other diseases of the kidney and bladder.

     Proved by Mrs. H. H. Dresser, whose excellent proving appears in full in Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 4, p. 237.

     For a full arrangement of the symptoms see Hering's Monograph.

CLINICAL AUTHORITIES.

- Cystitis (2 cases), B. L. Dresser, Am. Hom. Obs., vol. 3, p. 405 ; Retention of urine, B. L. Dresser, Am. Hom. Obs., vol. 3, p. 405 ; Intermittent fever (105 cases reported cured), Von Tagen, Hom. Clinics, vol. 4, p. 126 ; Hom. Clinics, vol. 1, pp. 3 and 52 ; Howard, Hom. Clinics, vol. 1, p. 16 ; (2 cases), Raue's Rec., 1871, p. 195 ; Raue's Rec., 1872, p. 244 ; Gardiner, Raue's Rec., 1870, p. 52 ; Analytical Therap., vol. 1, p. 266 ; Dropsy, Hale, A. II. O., vol. 1, p. 133.

   

MIND. [1] [Eup. pur.]
Stupid, dull. θ Dropsy. θ Intermittent.
Confusion with falling to left side.
The mind encompassed by various delusions.
Talkative ; exclamations ; delusions of sight and hearing.
Sighing every few minutes, with gnawing at stomach.
Moaning ; suffering expressed by peculiar cries.
Hysterical mood, weeping, sighing, and a feeling like home sickness, though occupying her own home and surrounded by her own family, with fluttering of heart and a disagreeable fulness in throat.
Feels extremely depressed and sleepy.
Has a great fear of sickness.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Eup. pur.]
Head feels light and dizzy, as though flying round and round ; cannot get rid of the sensation as if falling towards the left side ; the whole body seems to participate.
Lightness of head < in morning, disappearing at 12 o'clock.
Sensation as if her head were moving in all directions.
Illusions of sight and hearing, with vertigo.
Confused, heavy ; cannot seem to prevent falling.
Dull, sleepy ; great effort required in order to move about.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Eup. pur.]
Dull, heavy pain in head ; most severe in forehead.
Much headache and constriction over frontal region, with chill.
Dizzy, with deep, dull, aching pain through temporal region on left side.
Vertex full, pressing, as though lifting up from adjoining parts.
Head feels as though she had a bad cold.
Hard thumping pain on left occipital bone.
Pain from left shoulder extends to occiput.
Sick headache ; dull hammering, beating, stitching, or boring pain in left side of head ; pressing from right to left ; beginning in morning and increasing during afternoon and evening ; < in cold air ; > while walking slowly in fresh air.
Violent headache : before the chill ; during morning ; with fever.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Eup. pur.]
Fine pricking sensation on scalp, rather pleasurable than otherwise.
Soreness, tenderness, and itching of scalp.
Sweat, principally on head, particularly profuse about forehead.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Eup. pur.]
Staring ; looking with fixed eyes, wide open.
Cannot see as far as usual, with sleepy feeling.
Eyes weeping ; copious flow of tears.
Copious flow of tears, filling eyes, making constant wiping necessary.
Eyes red and swollen ; violent headache.
Conjunctiva yellow, with the chill.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Eup. pur.]
Ears feel as though they were full.
Squeaking sound in ears ; reports ; illusions of hearing.
Crackling, like burning of birch-bark ; very much < upon swallowing anything.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Eup. pur.]
Fluent coryza ; great heat, sneezing.
Abundant discharge of a thin, watery fluid, making nose sore and irritable.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Eup. pur.]
Congestion to face, with burning heat, dry and hot to touch.

Shining appearance of face, as when having used a large quantity of soap in washing.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Eup. pur.]
Lips blue. θ Intermittent.

Dull, deep pain in kidneys ; also cutting pain.

Suppression of urine.
Hard, aching pressure upon bladder ; evacuated bladder every half hour during day, still it is full and tense.

Incontinence of urine ; especially with children.
Restless tossing about ; constant moaning, expressed by peculiar cries ; lower belly swollen and hot.

Catarrh vesica, attended by ulceration.

Strangury, due to uterine displacement.
Ischuria with child two weeks old.
Constant urging to urinate all day ; has passed twice as much urine during the day as usual.

Profuse flow of clear, limpid urine ; weak, tired and faint after urinary symptoms.

Mucous sediment in urine in excess, indicating inflammation.

Renal and vesical calculi.
Diuresis and vesical irritation ; hyperemia and vesical inflammation.
Dysuria, enuresis nocturna, and other conditions of irritation of bladder from direct or reflex causes.
Vesical irritability in women.

FEVER. [40] [Eup. pur.]
Chilly down back, when changing position ever so little.
General coldness of whole body.
Chill begins in small of back, and spreads over body ; violent shaking, with comparatively little coldness ; bone pains ; thirst in chill and heat ; nails blue.

Pulse ranged from 80 to 100 ; full and bounding.
Chill commences in small of back and extends from this point up and down body simultaneously ; slightest movement while covered, or draft of air blowing upon patient, produces a transient return of chill after it has apparently passed away, and after the fever has set in ; this is also the case during the sweat, but not so marked severe bone pains. θ Intermittent fever.
During morning, headache, pain in lumbar region, arms, legs, and left side of throat ; after 3 P. M., chilly feeling in lumbar region, extending up as far as between shoulder blades, cold hands and feet, finger-nails blue, general coldness ; after from one to three hours, fever, flushed face, suffused eyes, lachrymation, running at nose ; constant thirst ; desire for cold and acid drinks ; loss of appetite ; restless sleep, with frightful dreams.
At 10 A. M., every other day, begins to yawn, gape, stretch out, and then to shake ; coldness appears to commence about trunk first, while hands and feet become so in half or three-quarters of an hour afterwards ; finger and toe-nails become blue ; child does not shake continually during the chill, but appears to shudder at intervals for a moment or so ; after two hours slight fever with thirst, both continuing about an hour and followed by perspiration, particularly about upper portion of body. θ Quotidian intermittent.

From below upwards : sore pain directly within spine ; neuralgic pains hip and back.

TISSUES. [44] [Eup. pur.]
Through the spinal nervous system it produces a state of muscular system similar to rheumatism ; it probably affects the anterior portion of spinal cord the most.
Through the renal plexus, this remedy has a specific and special action upon the kidneys, acting as a powerful diuretic, producing great increase of urinary secretion ; large doses produce vesical irritation, with frequent desire to urinate, which is very urgent and painful ; urine loaded with mucus, and high-colored and scanty.
Distressing dyspnœa ; whole body and extremities extremely œdematous ; secretion of urine very scanty, only 3 or 4 ounces in twenty-four hours ; no organic disease discernible ; urine however slightly albuminous ; pulse feeble but regular ; extremities cold ; considerable general prostration. θ Dropsy.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Eup. pur.]
After riding four miles a very rough road, with much jolting and shaking, while pregnant, violent dysuria.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Eup. pur.]
Infant, æt. 2 weeks ; retention of urine.
Babe, æt. 11 months, living in a miasmatic district, is pale, wan, debilitated ; intermittent fever.
Girl, æt. 2 1/2 years, delicate, pale, frail, living in a miasmatic district, was seized with convulsions, followed by paroxysm of intermittent fever.
Girl, æt. 6 years ; intermittent fever.
Miss. C., æt. 20 ; intermittent fever.
Mrs. P., pregnant 7 months, after riding over a rough road and being greatly jolted and shaken ; cystitis.
Elias S. after enlisting in army took violent cold ; chronic cystitis.
Old gentleman ; twice had attacks of dropsy ; dropsy.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Eup. pur.]
Compare : Apoc., (dropsy), Cann. sat., Canthar., Copaiva, Ferrum and Senecio (renal symptoms).
